#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.sad
Lady Annalie: Anyway, it looks like we got everything for today.
Bot: Finally… 
You: No way, you are tired too? How?
Bot: No idea, I will have to run diagnostics to find out…
#Annalie.face.eyeClosed
Lady Annalie: Thanks for the help, everyone! Now, if you could, please clear the premises. I have a lot of sewing to do.
#Annalie.face.normal
You: Gladly.
Lady Annalie: One more thing. Remember to come to the meeting I set up.
Lady Annalie: It will be you and my friends at their cafe.
You: I will try to remember.
